text: Fix the root cause of three failed tries at adding the 'root-cause' default (69gf, t1y6): the reader's always-loaded set carries every default's full statement, so it is at 1799 of 1800 tokens and any new default must cut meaning to fit. The reader only needs enough to choose which defaults apply; the full statements matter in the producer and verifier briefs, which carry only the named defaults. Give the reader a compact form of each default and keep full statements for the briefs, then add the 'root-cause' default with its full meaning: fix where the fault originates, not the symptom or the one instance that surfaced; name an out-of-scope cause and propose the fix rather than working around it; the change's description names the root cause and why the change addresses it; relation to 'small': the root-cause fix is the one focused change. Its source is the BRIEF.md addendum '2026-10-13: Root causes'. Do not raise budgets or edit BRIEF.md. If a new defaults.toml field is needed, mind that the installed gate must still parse the file in the same commit.
